newsitem.title: USA: NY Senate to soon vote on casino gambling - paper.
newsitem.headline: NY Senate to soon vote on casino gambling - paper.

text.p: The New York State Senate plans to vote next Monday or Tuesday on a constitutional amendment that would legalize casino gambling, New York Post reported Wednesday.
It is not certain the Senate will pass the measure.
The Republican-controlled Senate had planned to wait until the Democrat-led Assembly, which is expected to approve the bill, had acted.
But Senate Majority Leader Joseph Bruno, R-Troy, changed his strategy when it became clear Senate Democrats were hoping to gain political leverage, the paper said.

Lobbying against the measure are those who represent casinos in Atlantic City, N.J., off-includes Track betting corporations and Indian tribes, according to the newspaper. In favor of the bill are Catskills resorts and racetracks.
